claims: Gonzaga University is located in Spokane, Washington.
Gonzaga University's main campus is 152 acres.
Gonzaga University's main campus is situated along the north bank of the Spokane River.
Gonzaga University's main campus is approximately half a mile from Spokane's downtown business district.
Gonzaga University's address is 502 E Boone Ave, Spokane, WA 99258.
Gonzaga University's campus is primarily located in the Logan residential neighborhood.
Gonzaga University is in Eastern Washington.
Gonzaga University is about 279 miles east of Seattle.
Gonzaga University is approximately a 30-minute drive from the Idaho border.
Gonzaga University is near Spokane Falls.
Gonzaga University is surrounded by the "Inland Northwest" landscape of mountains, lakes, and forests.
Gonzaga University operates a second campus in Florence, Italy.
Gonzaga University is a private Jesuit university.
Gonzaga University's campus features over 100 buildings.
Gonzaga University's campus includes the landmark St. Aloysius Church.
Gonzaga University's campus includes the state-of-the-art John J. Hemmingson Center.
